description_en: Queries the list of job templates
description_zh: 调用ListJobTemplates查询作业模板列表
name: ListJobTemplates

parameters.help_en:
The name of the job template.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87248.html operation to obtain the job template name
parameters.help_zh:
作业模板名称。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87248.html获取模板名称
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The page number to return. Pages start from page 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
当前页码。起始值：1

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return per page. Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。最大值：50

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page

ArrayRequest.description_en:
The queue of the job.

Format: X-Y:Z. X is the minimum index value. Y is the maximum index value. Z is the step size. For example, 2-7:2 indicates that three jobs need to be run and their index values are 2, 4, and 6
ArrayRequest.description_zh:
作业队列。

格式为X-Y:Z， 最小值X是第一个索引，最大值Y是最后一个索引，Z表示步长，例如2-7:2，表示作业队列包含编号为2、4、6的3个子作业

ClockTime.description_en:
The maximum running time of the job. Valid formats:

hh:mm:ss
mm:ss
ss
ClockTime.description_zh:
作业最大运行时间。支持三种格式：
hh:mm:ss
mm:ss
ss

CommandLine.description_en: The command that is used to run the job

Gpu.description_en:
The maximum GPU usage for individual compute nodes. Valid values: 1 to 8.

The parameter takes effect only when the cluster uses PBS and a compute node is a GPU-accelerated instance
Gpu.description_zh:
单个计算节点使用GPU的数量。可能值：1~8。

仅支持使用pbs调度器的集群，且集群内计算节点含GPU时该参数生效

Id.description_en: The ID of the job template

InputFileUrl.description_en: The URL of the job files that are uploaded to an Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket
InputFileUrl.description_zh: 已上传到OSS上的作业文件链接

Mem.description_en: The maximum memory usage of a single compute node. The unit can be GB, MB, or KB, and is case-insensitive
Mem.description_zh: 单个计算节点最大使用内存数。支持GB、MB、KB，单位不区分大小写

Name.description_en: The name of the job template

Node.description_en: The number of compute nodes. Valid values: 1 to 500
Node.description_zh: 提交作业所需计算节点数。可能值：1~500

PackagePath.description_en: The path that is used to run the job

Priority.description_en: The priority of the job. Valid values: 0 to 9. A larger value indicates a higher priority
Priority.description_zh: 作业优先级。可能值：0~9，取值越大，优先级越高

ReRunable.description_en:
Specifies whether the job can be rerun. Valid values:

true: The job can be rerun.
false: The job cannot be rerun
ReRunable.description_zh:
是否支持重新执行作业。可能值：

true：支持

false：不支持

RunasUser.description_en: The name of the user that runs the job

StderrRedirectPath.description_en: The output file path of stderr

StdoutRedirectPath.description_en: The output file path of stdout

Task.description_en: The number of tasks required by a single compute node. Valid values: 1 to 1000
Task.description_zh: 单个计算节点所需任务数。可能值：1~1000

Thread.description_en: The number of threads required by a single task. Valid values: 1 to 1000
Thread.description_zh: 单个任务所需线程数。可能值：1~1000

UnzipCmd.description_en:
The command that is used to decompress the job files downloaded from an OSS bucket. The parameter takes effect only when WithUnzipCmd is set to true. Valid values:

tar xzf: decompresses GZIP files.
tar xf: decompresses TAR files.
unzip: decompresses ZIP files
UnzipCmd.description_zh:
解压命令，当WithUnzipCmd取值为true时，该参数生效。取值范围：

tar xzf：解开gzip格式压缩包

tar xf：解开tar格式压缩包

unzip：解开zip格式压缩包

Variables.description_en: The environment variables of the job

WithUnzipCmd.description_en:
Specifies whether to decompress the job files downloaded from an OSS bucket. Valid value:

true: decompresses the job file.
false: does not decompress the job file
WithUnzipCmd.description_zh:
是否解压下载后的作业文件。取值范围：

true：是

false：否

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of returned entries
